|lore=
|game_text='''0 side – Imperial Occupation (V)'''<br />''Deploy Hoth system, Ice Plains, and Main Power Generators (Light Side). May deploy Imperial Decree.'' '''For''' remainder of game, AT-ATs are deploy -1. You may not deploy Colo Claw Fish. Revolution is canceled. '''While''' this side up, AT-ATs may move for free. Rebels are deploy -1 to Hoth sites. Opponent loses no Force to You May Start Your Landing. During your control phase, may take one AT-AT Cannon, Electro-Rangefinder, Death Squadron, a [Virtual] AT-AT, or a [Virtual] Epic Event into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. '''Flip''' this card if Main Power Generators ‘blown away.’<br /><br />'''7 side – Imperial Control (V)'''<br />'''While''' this side up, Rebel Base Occupation is canceled. Walker Garrison is an Out Of Play Interrupt and (Immune to Sense.). Rebels are deploy +1 to Hoth sites. Your total battle destiny at Hoth system is +1 for each Imperial there. Unless opponent controls a Hoth location, your Force drain bonuses may not be canceled. Once per turn, when you deploy an AT-AT, may take any one card (except an Interrupt or vehicle) from Lost Pile into hand. During your deploy phase, may deploy a marker site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
|printings='''Virtual Original''' — [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]<br />'''Virtual Original Errata''' — '''this page''' (<code>1104_40</code>)<br />'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]] (<code>1220_72o</code>)<br />'''Virtual Legacy Errata''' — [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V) (Errata)]] (<code>2220_1072</code>)<br />'''Virtual Legacy Errata 2''' — [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V) (Errata 2)]] (<code>1220_72</code>)
|errata_history={{Card errata/Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth)}}
|notes=[[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V) (Virtual Set 4)|Original 40a/40b]], [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]] and [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth) (PC Gallery Text)|PC gallery text]] each represent a complete pair. The original front and reverse are collector 40a and 40b. The December-2006 official sheet uses 40 for both. The independently archived Players Committee pair was captured 16 December 2007. Its front matches the dated later front. Its reverse says “May ▼ a marker site” without naming a phase, while the dated later reverse names the deploy phase. Ordinary site deployment rules still require the owner’s deploy phase. The One Rule separately limits a singular action when the card names a time frame. The unqualified wording can allow additional eligible separate pulls during that same deploy phase. The gallery capture does not establish its first issue or precedence. The two displayed CardMaker images follow the December 2006 official PDF.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153629/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards4.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 4, slip 40. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
